title: Control Allocation with Adaptive Augmentation for Aerodynamic Optimization of Trailing Edge Morphing Aircraft
summary: This paper presents a control allocation framework with adaptive augmentation for a trailing edge morphing aircraft, providing stability guarantees under uncertainty while exploiting the available morphing degrees of freedom to optimize aerodynamic efficiency. A baseline controller is designed using the nominal aircraft model to establish the desired closed-loop reference dynamics. For the aerodynamics, the wing shape is optimized dependent on the flight state to achieve a target elliptical lift distribution corresponding to minimum induced drag.
